mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_archive (company_id, order_id, order_no, customer_id, purchase_done, sale_draft_done, outbound_done, invoice_done, receipt_done, is_archived) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{purchaseDone}, #{saleDraftDone}, #{outboundDone}, #{invoiceDone}, #{receiptDone}, #{isArchived})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order po INNER JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON po.id = poi.order_id WHERE po.order_id = #{orderId} AND po.status = 2 -- 已入库状态
